cn.t: Sondheim's unfinished final work divides critics with its surreal take on Buñuel's films—the first act's satirical wit earns praise, but the song-sparse second half disappoints, leaving a flawed yet intriguing swansong elevated by stellar performances.

vr.q: I am glad to have got to a place where I feel as though I understand it a little bit better.
